messages:
sam: Heads up 1: sudden packing jitter in ap-south1 — tiny services are getting scattered across 6 nodes, mediums can't co-locate and preempt evictions spiked. Rack-shard looks overloaded.

tara: Did we change any scheduling policy or nic egress weights last night?

sam: Not on purpose. infra pushed an experimental qdisc-based egress limiter to a subset of nodes (rack-3) for testing.

noah: Scheduler logs show a lot of score tie-breaks then fallback to spread: 
`score(nodeA)=50 score(nodeB)=50 -> prefSpread applied`
That's our binpack->spread flip kicking in when egress_penalty trumps pack_score.

dee: Quick mitigation: can we mark tiny pods with a soft-hint label apps/pack:coalesce and adjust podpriority to prefer packer?

sam: Applied canary label to tiny-runner in ap-south1c: `kubectl label deploy tiny-runner apps/pack=coalesce --overwrite` pending dropped ~65% in canary.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-6543 created; alerting oncall.

infra: I'll pause the qdisc rollout and revert egress limiter on rack-3. Also will bump net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max on the affected nodes as precaution.

noah: We should add a scheduler soft-mode that prefers homogeneous packing when >50% pending are <0.25 GPU. I'll sketch a config flag and a unit-test.

tara: Requesting telemetry: per-rack packing_entropy and tiny_pod_coalesce_rate. Make a heatmap tile on packer dash.

sam: Cost note: short window estimate ~22% extra vGPU-hours due to poor co-location. Leaving thread open for 1.5h to confirm stability. :thumbsup:
